review_candidates.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Senior Cloud Security Engineer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to strengthen and maintain the security of our cloud infrastructure, primarily across AWS, with additional experience in Azure and enterprise identity management. The role will be responsible for implementing cloud security strategies, managing access controls, identifying and addressing security vulnerabilities, and ensuring the protection of infrastructure, applications, and business data. K
eligibility_evidence: Knowledge of secrets management, cloud security posture management, and hybrid identity integration.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on technical expertise in AWS security, cloud governance, and identity management, with the ability to drive security improvements and collaborate effectively with cross-functional technical teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, information security, or cybersecurity, with significant hands-on experience in AWS security. Hands-on experience securing Azure resources and managing Microsoft Entra ID configurations. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent.
